locale.description: Locale for the label. Defaults to the surrounding locale context, then the browser's language.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the label is read in. Defaults to the viewer's zone.

format.description:
`relative` reads "4 min ago", "1 h ago", then "Yesterday, 4:12 PM". `absolute` always reads
the clock ("Today, 10:44 AM", "Sun Nov 1, 4:12 PM"). The tooltip carries the other reading.

tick.description: Recalculate the label on an interval. Set false to disable ticking.

unsupportedProps.name: date
unsupportedProps.description: The moment to show: a `Date`, an ISO string or epoch milliseconds. Defaults to now.
